question: The mean proportional between 9 + 3sqrt{7} and 18 - 6sqrt{7}
solution:
**Given:**

First number = 9 + 3√(7)

Second number = 18 - 6√(7)

**Formula Used:**

**Calculation:**

First number = 9 + 3√(7)

Second number = 18 - 6√(7)

Product = (9 + 3√(7)) × (18 - 6√(7))

⇒ 9 × 18 + 9 × (-6√(7)) + 3√(7) × 18 + 3√(7) × (-6√(7))

⇒ 162 - 54√(7) + 54√(7) - 126

⇒ 162 - 126

⇒ 36

Mean Proportional = √(36)

⇒ 6

**The mean proportional is 6.**
